name: Beclometasone
executiveSummary: Inhaled/nasal corticosteroid. Adult asthma MDI: usual **100–400 µg q12h** (up to **800 µg/day** by severity; extrafine HFA lower µg). Pediatrics: **50–100 µg q12h**. Rhinitis: **50–100 µg/nostril 1–2×/day**. Not acute rescue.
indications:
## Indications

- Persistent asthma (controller).
- Allergic rhinitis (nasal spray).

## Precautions

- Rinse mouth after inhalation (thrush).
- Distinguish CFC vs extrafine HFA (µg equivalences differ).
- Fixed combos with salbutamol: different role than PRN SABA.

> Attack: salbutamol ± systemic steroid.

adulto.dose: Asthma: **100–200 µg q12h** (range **200–800 µg/day**; severe up to **1000–2000 µg/day** on older labels — prefer lowest effective). Nasal: **50–100 µg/nostril 1–2×/day**.
adulto.administration: Inhale with spacer if needed; nasal after clearing nostrils.
adulto.notes: Do not stop abruptly after high prolonged doses.

pediatrico.dose: Asthma ≥5 y: often **50–100 µg q12h** (max per label ~**400 µg/day**). Nasal ≥6 y: **50 µg/nostril 1–2×/day**.

stability:
## Stability

- Store inhaler per label; shake MDI before use.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Dysphonia, oral thrush, cough; nasal: epistaxis. Systemic effects rare at usual doses.
